questions.question: What interests you about moving from medical data analytics into a Salesforce Industries Communications Cloud and telecom Quote-to-Cash architecture role?
Your background includes substantial SQL and MS SQL Server work. Can you describe a complex data extraction or transformation you built, including the source data, validation approach, and outcome?
In your Medical Data Analyst role, how did you ensure clinical and financial data integrity before it was used for analysis or reporting?

Describe a situation where you had to explain a technical data, analytics, or system limitation to clinicians, stakeholders, or non-technical users. How did you communicate the options and implications?

This role requires designing solutions involving Salesforce APIs and third-party integrations. What experience do you have working with data interfaces, system-to-system data exchange, or integrating data from multiple sources?

You have used SAS and SQL to support population management and care-management programs. How would you approach learning and applying Salesforce data models, OmniStudio, and Vlocity tools in a Quote-to-Cash implementation?
Tell us about a time you investigated a data-quality issue or system problem, such as your work related to Care Alerts or the Health Information Portal. What was your troubleshooting process?
How have you documented analytical logic, data definitions, technical processes, or reporting methodologies so that other team members could review and reuse your work?
Describe an occasion when you presented analysis results or technical findings to a workgroup, faculty, clinicians, or leadership. How did you tailor the presentation for the audience?

This position involves guiding onsite and offshore teams through implementation. What experience do you have coordinating work, training others, or supervising team members, and how would you apply that experience in a technical delivery environment?
